description: This source file implements WebSocket and HTTP handlers for WebRTC signaling, device communication, and client management within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It includes classes for handling WebSocket connections, message forwarding, polling, and configuration, as well as utility functions for generating random client secrets.

classes.name: ClientWSHandler
classes.description: Handles WebSocket communication with clients, managing connection requests, message forwarding, and disconnections.

classes.name: ClientWSHandlerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of ClientWSHandler.

classes.name: PollConnectionHandler
classes.description: Manages polling messages for clients, queues messages, and handles device association.

classes.name: PollConnectionStore
classes.description: Stores and manages PollConnectionHandler instances identified by connection IDs.

classes.name: ClientDynHandler
classes.description: Base class for dynamic HTTP handlers, providing JSON parsing and response utilities.

classes.name: ConnectHandler
classes.description: Handles connection requests from clients to devices, establishing device sessions.

classes.name: ForwardHandler
classes.description: Handles forwarding messages from clients to devices.

classes.name: PollHandler
classes.description: Handles polling requests to retrieve queued messages for clients.

classes.name: ConfigHandler
classes.description: Provides server configuration details via HTTP GET requests.

methods.name: RandomClientSecret
methods.description: Generates a random string of specified length consisting of digits and letters for client secrets.

methods.name: ClientWSHandler::OnClosed
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a WebSocket connection is closed.

methods.name: ClientWSHandler::SendDeviceMessage
methods.description: Sends a device message to the client over WebSocket.

methods.name: ClientWSHandler::handleMessage
methods.description: Dispatches incoming messages based on their type.

methods.name: ClientWSHandler::handleConnectionRequest
methods.description: Processes connection requests from clients to devices.

methods.name: ClientWSHandler::handleForward
methods.description: Processes forwarding messages from clients to devices.

methods.name: ClientWSHandlerFactory::Build
methods.description: Creates a new WebSocket handler instance.

methods.name: PollConnectionHandler::SendDeviceMessage
methods.description: Queues a message to be sent to the client.

methods.name: PollConnectionHandler::PollMessages
methods.description: Retrieves and clears queued messages.

methods.name: PollConnectionHandler::SetDeviceHandler
methods.description: Associates a device handler with the connection.

methods.name: PollConnectionHandler::SetClientId
methods.description: Sets the client ID for the connection.

methods.name: PollConnectionStore::Get
methods.description: Retrieves a PollConnectionHandler by connection ID.

methods.name: PollConnectionStore::Add
methods.description: Adds a new PollConnectionHandler and generates a unique connection ID.

methods.name: ClientDynHandler::DoGet
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests; returns MethodNotAllowed for this handler.

methods.name: ClientDynHandler::Reply
methods.description: Sends a JSON response.

methods.name: ClientDynHandler::ReplyError
methods.description: Sends an error message as JSON.

methods.name: ClientDynHandler::DoPost
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests, parsing JSON input.

methods.name: ClientDynHandler::Poll
methods.description: Retrieves and sends queued messages to the client.

methods.name: ConnectHandler::DoPostInner
methods.description: Processes device connection requests and establishes device sessions.

methods.name: ForwardHandler::DoPostInner
methods.description: Forwards messages from clients to devices.

methods.name: PollHandler::DoPostInner
methods.description: Handles polling requests to retrieve messages.

methods.name: ConfigHandler::DoGet
methods.description: Returns server configuration as JSON.

methods.name: ConfigHandler::DoPost
methods.description: Method not allowed for POST requests.
